item.text: I’m using the pinned spec-to-code-compliance instructions to extract verbatim requirements from `RaffleFactory.sol` and save the extraction report in the designated output directory.

The comments specify deployment checks, operational guarantees, and deployment-time trust assumptions. I’m splitting compound claims, retaining verbatim quotations, and flagging terms such as “autonomous” and “locked” where the text does not define a precise check.
